regime_context: US thematic board is narrow and top-heavy in semiconductors/AI infrastructure: AI Infra leads with high durability (0.71) and breadth (0.875) but 'val_state: fading'; Memory/HBM and WFE are tight challengers. Rotation breadth is narrowing (0.41, non-directional), gate_helps is true so absolute-trend discipline has historically cut drawdown here, and track_record hit_rate is decent (0.679) but direction accuracy is near coin-flip (0.488) — so I keep conviction low and lean only where the trend-gate leg plus breadth/durability support a defensible conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching Memory/HBM & Storage (rank 2) to see whether it overtakes AI Infrastructure as leader with an energy-driven advance: if Memory/HBM rises to rank 1 while AI Infra's durability_bar falls below 0.65 and its breadth drops under 0.8, that would confirm a handoff to the semiconductor challenger and retire the watch.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Among the board leaders this is the only one combining eligibility, a 'trend' hurst tag (vs 'mixed' for the #1 AI Infra), solid durability (0.72), decent breadth (0.75), and no crowding (z=0.15). It is the challenger in the rotation structure with a real persistence signature, and the absolute-trend gate blesses it — this is a trend-following lean, not a momentum-rank return forecast.
evidence: rotation challenger to AI Infra, margin 0.422
theses.dissent: It shares the SMH proxy with three other top-5 themes, so 'Memory/HBM' leadership may simply be the semiconductor complex as a whole — and a broad semi flush would hit it just as hard as its fading leader AI Infra.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its own 20-day average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is eligible with full breadth (1.0) and the highest durability on the board (0.83), but crowding_z is 1.97 — explicitly 'crowded'. Per guardrails, crowding is never a fade or short; it is a size-down caution. The only honest directional expression of 'don't chase this much attention into a crowded trend' is an underweight/avoid lean, and only because crowding already sits at a documented attention extreme.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend but eligibility driven by already-hot attention
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and the theme still has the strongest trend-health profile on the board — being early on an underweight works against a durable trend as often as it helps.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a fresh 20-day high and holds above it for 5 sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with a 'mean-revert' hurst tag, near-zero durability (0.15), and collapsed breadth (0.25). The absolute-trend gate — the one validated risk-control leg — explicitly removes it. This is a pure gate-discipline avoid, not a valuation or momentum call.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert themes can bounce hard after shakeouts, and Silver Miners is one of the only non-semiconductor names scoring positive — an avoid could miss a sharp reflexive recovery.

falsifier.text: SIL closes back above its own 50-day average and the theme flips eligible=true before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
